visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and a prominent cyan hair extension stands in a brightly lit clothing store aisle. He wears a black graphic T-shirt and grey joggers, waving his hands and pointing to the environment while speaking with an exaggeratedly distressed facial expression. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot where the man has changed into a white sleeveless top. He demonstrates the fabric by pulling it away from his chest and gesturing towards the cooling racks in the background. (3) He inserts long, white plastic vampire teeth into his mouth and poses with a wide grin. He then flexes his biceps and moves his body rhythmically, appearing to celebrate the sensation of the cold clothing against his skin. (4) Wearing a black T-shirt again, he stands before several mannequins dressed in white. He performs deep formal bows and gestures with his hands in a mock-ceremonial fashion, looking directly into the camera with a playful and challenging stare. (5) He tries on a blue and white patterned short-sleeved shirt over a white undershirt. He walks through the store aisles, showing off the garment's fit while various yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen. (6) He walks into another man wearing a grey T-shirt. The collision is staged, and the main character quickly adjusts his expression from shock to a calm, polite smile, pointing at his shirt to explain his improved mood. (7) Standing near a display of child-sized mannequins, he points at the small garments and gestures towards the camera. The background shows organized shelves of folded clothes and bright overhead studio-style lighting throughout the retail space. (8) In the final sequence, he pushes a silver shopping cart while holding a smartphone to his ear. He gestures with his free hand and walks towards the camera with a confident, high-energy stride before the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A loud, gravelly male voice shouts in a high-arousal tone about the summer heat. A fast-tempo electronic BGM with a heavy, driving beat starts immediately. (2) Vocal tone becomes more rhythmic as he mentions the store '50percent'. Digital 'whoosh' sound effects emphasize scene transitions every few seconds. (3) The speaker's delivery shifts into a more comedic, exaggerated register with sharp pitch rises as he mentions 'teeth'. High-tempo BGM maintains a steady energy floor. (4) A short melodic loop plays while the speaker performs a rhythmic chant with a professional, mock-serious tone. Background noise is virtually non-existent, indicating post-production cleanup. (5) A sharp 'ding' sound effect highlights the mention of the price. The speech rate increases significantly, approaching a rap-like density of information. (6) A sudden percussive 'thud' SFX occurs during the collision scene, followed by a momentary drop in vocal volume to a polite, conversational level. (7) High-arousal narration returns as he discusses family clothing options. BGM continues with high percussive texture and bright spectral brightness. (8) The video concludes with a sequence of fast-paced talking while on a phone call. The BGM swells slightly before a final hard cut to silence.
